description: Sync records, notes and file attachments from the Zoho CRM modules you choose, including custom modules. Zoho CRM permissions are not imported.
opening: Sync the Zoho CRM modules you select: leads, contacts, accounts, deals, tasks, cases, notes, and custom and other modules. Each record is one document, with its description and its other visible fields as labeled lines. Each note and each file attached to a record is its own document, linked to that record. Uploaded files in supported formats are read, and their text is searchable.

Zoho CRM sharing and permissions are not imported, so every synced item is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. In a module that has only a creation date, edits to older records can be missed. Records deleted in Zoho CRM can stay in HydraDB.

synced.text: Zoho CRM items are stored with the provider value `zoho-crm`, with a hyphen. Use that value when you filter on `provider`.

notes: Zoho CRM module visibility, record owners and record sharing are not reproduced.

connect.auth: Zoho CRM uses an OAuth client id and secret with a refresh token for the account.

credentials.name: refresh_token
credentials.text: A Zoho OAuth refresh token for the account.

credentials.name: data_center
credentials.text: The Zoho data center of the account, such as `com`, `in`, `eu`, `com.au`, `jp` or `ca`. Defaults to `com`, the US data center. A refresh token works only in its own data center.

steps.title: Create an OAuth client
steps.text: In Zoho, create an OAuth client and generate a refresh token for the account you want to sync.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the client id, client secret and refresh token. If your Zoho account is not in the US data center, set `data_center`, or the token is rejected.

steps.title: Select modules
steps.text: HydraDB lists the modules in the account. Select the ones to sync. Only selected modules sync.

connect.account: One connector reads one Zoho CRM account.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default. A module with no modification or creation date is read in full.
sync.changes: A module with a modification date picks up records changed since the last sync. A module with only a creation date picks up new records. A module with neither is read in full on every sync. Files are listed only for records synced in the same sync.
sync.edits: An edited record updates its document when its module has a modification date or is read in full. In a module with only a creation date, edits to older records can be missed.
sync.deletes: Records deleted in Zoho CRM can stay searchable in HydraDB.
notes: Zoho users are read on every sync to name record owners. They are not documents of their own.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.zoho_crm_id
shared_attributes.text: The Zoho CRM record id. Targets one record, and keeps later syncs on the same document. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.zoho_crm_module
shared_attributes.text: The module's API name in lower case, such as `deals`. Limits a query to one module. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: provider
shared_attributes.text: Always `zoho-crm`, with a hyphen. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: Other module fields
shared_attributes.text: Every other visible field of the module, written as labeled lines. A link to another record is written as that record's name or email. Hidden fields are left out.

documents.name: Leads, contacts and accounts
documents.title: For a lead or contact, the full name, else the first and last name, the company or the email. For an account, the account name. Otherwise a title with the record id.
documents.text: The description, then `Label: value` lines. Leads: `Name`, `Company`, `Status`, `Email` and `Owner`. Contacts: `Name`, `Account`, `Email`, `Title` and `Owner`. Accounts: `Account`, `Industry`, `Website` and `Owner`. Then the module's other fields, then the owner's email. The name is searchable too.
documents.date: When the record was last modified, else when it was created.
documents.link_back: The record's URL field, else its website, when it has one. This can be the company's website rather than the record in Zoho CRM.
documents.files: Files attached to the record are their own documents.

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.text: The person's or account's name. For a lead or contact, the graph treats the record as that person.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.text: Person for leads and contacts, organization for accounts. Decides whether the record stands for a person in the graph.

attributes.name: email
attributes.text: The primary email, else another email on the record. Identifies the person in the graph.

attributes.name: emails
attributes.text: The record's other email addresses. Connected to the same person in the graph.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.text: The first name.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.text: The last name.

attributes.name: phones
attributes.text: The record's phone numbers, so a person can be found by phone.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.text: The person's title or designation.

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.text: The account name on a contact, the company name on a lead.

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.text: The id of a contact's account. Links the contact to the account as a member.

attributes.name: company
attributes.text: A lead's company, written as the `Company` line.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: A lead's status, written as the `Status` line.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.text: A contact's account name, written as the `Account` line.

attributes.name: industry
attributes.text: An account's industry, written as the `Industry` line.

attributes.name: website
attributes.text: An account's website, written as the `Website` line.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.text: The contact status, lead status or account type.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.text: The record's labels.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.text: The record's tags.

attributes.name: url
attributes.text: The record's URL field, else its website. Used as the link back.

attributes.name: provider_user_id
attributes.text: The Zoho CRM record id. Identifies the person in the graph, and keeps later syncs on the same document.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.text: The owner's name or email, written as the `Owner` line. The graph records the owner of the record.

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.text: The owner's email. Identifies the owner in the graph.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the record was created. Used as the result date only when the modification time is missing.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the record was last modified.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: A copy of the record's name.

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.text: The owner's Zoho user id.

attributes.name: object_type
attributes.text: The module name in lower case. Filter on it with `additional_metadata.zoho_crm_module`.

documents.name: Deals, tasks and cases
documents.title: A deal's name. For a task or case, its subject or title. Otherwise a title with the record id.
documents.text: For a deal, the description, then `Deal`, `Account`, `Stage`, `Amount`, `Closing date` and `Owner` lines, then its other fields. For a task or case, all its fields as labeled lines. The title and creation time are searchable too.
documents.date: When the record was last modified, else when it was created.
documents.files: Files attached to the record are their own documents.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.text: A deal's amount, written as the `Amount` line.

attributes.name: stage
attributes.text: A deal's stage, written as the `Stage` line.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.text: A deal's expected closing date, written as the `Closing date` line. It is not the result date.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.text: The linked account's name, written as the `Account` line.

attributes.name: email
attributes.text: The record's email field, when it has one.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.text: The owner's name, written as the `Owner` line.

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.text: The owner's email.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the record was created, written as a `Created` line. Used as the result date only when the modification time is missing.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the record was last modified. Not searchable.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: A copy of the record's title.

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.text: The owner's Zoho user id.

attributes.name: object_type
attributes.text: The module name in lower case. Filter on it with `additional_metadata.zoho_crm_module`.

documents.name: Notes
documents.one_document: One note. Notes with neither content nor a title are skipped.
documents.title: `Comment by` and the note owner's name or email. Without one, the first 80 characters of the text.
documents.text: A `Parent` line naming the record the note is on, with its id, module and name. Then the note content, or the note title when there is no content, then the note's other fields. The author and the created and updated times are part of the text too.
documents.date: When the note was last modified, else when it was created.

attributes.name: author
attributes.text: The note owner's name or email. The graph records the note as written by that person.

attributes.name: note_title
attributes.text: The note's title. Searchable when the note has no content. Otherwise it is kept with the note.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The record the note is on, written in the `Parent` line. Links the note to that record, in any module.

attributes.name: parent_name
attributes.text: The name of the record the note is on, written in the `Parent` line.

attributes.name: parent_module
attributes.text: The module of the record the note is on, written in the `Parent` line when it is known.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.zoho_crm_parent_id
attributes.text: The id of the record the note is on. Returns every note on one record. Not searchable.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the note was created, written as a `Created` line. Used as the result date only when the modification time is missing.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the note was last modified, written as an `Updated` line.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.text: A copy of the note owner. The author is the searchable value.

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.text: The note owner's Zoho user id.

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.text: The note owner's email.

documents.name: Attachments
documents.one_document: One file attached to a record.
documents.title: The file name. Otherwise a title with the attachment id.
documents.text: The file name with `File type`, `Size` and `Parent name` lines, the file's other fields, the owner and an `Updated` line. When the file was downloaded and read, its text is searchable too.
documents.date: When the attachment was last modified, else when it was created.
documents.files: Uploaded files in supported formats up to 50 MiB are downloaded and read. Larger files keep only their details. Link attachments are not downloaded. Files attached to notes are not synced.

attributes.name: file_type
attributes.text: The file type Zoho reports, written as the `File type` line. It is not always a MIME type.

attributes.name: size
attributes.text: The file size in bytes, written as the `Size` line.

attributes.name: parent_name
attributes.text: The name of the record the file is attached to, written as the `Parent name` line.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The record the file is attached to. Links the file to that record when its module is known. Written into the text only when the record's name is missing.

attributes.name: parent_module
attributes.text: The module of the record the file is attached to. Makes sure the link goes to the right kind of record. Written into the text only when the record's name is missing.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.zoho_crm_parent_id
attributes.text: The id of the record the file is attached to. Returns every file on one record. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.zoho_crm_parent_module
attributes.text: The module of the record the file is attached to. Finds files by their record's module. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.zoho_crm_parent_kind
attributes.text: The kind of record the file is attached to. Finds files by that kind. Not searchable.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the attachment was last modified, written as the `Updated` line.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the attachment was created. Used as the result date only when the modification time is missing. Not searchable.

attributes.name: object_type
attributes.text: Always `attachments`.

example_searches: Which deals for Acme are at the Negotiation stage?
What notes were left on this lead?
What does the contract attached to the Acme account say?

connections: A note to the record it is on, in any module.
A file to the record it is attached to.
A deal or contact to its account, and a contact to its account as a member.
Any record to every record named in its lookup fields, up to 100 per record.
people: A lead or contact stands for that person, identified by name and email.
The owner of each lead, contact and account.
Owners of other records appear only in their text.
graph.from_text: Descriptions, note content, the text read from attached files, and the other fields of each record.

not_synced: Profiles, roles, territories, currencies and organization settings.
The contents of link attachments, and the text of files over 50 MiB.
